description: Turbo Shiba Cop 3000 is a lost 16-bit game about a dog cop from the future. $TSC3000 — a community memecoin on Solana.

hero.text: One dog. One badge. One donut. Turbo has been on patrol since the year 3000.

about.title: The game nobody ever played
text: In 1994 a game about a dog cop from the year 3000 hit the shelves. Or it was supposed to. Nobody saw it, nobody played it, no magazine ever reviewed it.
Thirty years later the cartridge turned up. Inside: Turbo, a Shiba Inu with an action-hero body, mirrored shades and a donut he takes more seriously than his badge.
He patrols Solana. He never smiles. He is after the cat who steals rugs.
